line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R1987 one successful locked lookup supplies ConsoleRecordExists; only an existing record with a duplicate event is queried. No record, no event, failed query or signaled event yields false pending. The caller needs both answers to choose the original CheckDOS admission path. R1982/83/90/91 retain record-local early-return notification; zero-initialize on allocation, publish on decrement, consume on eligible Get. Prior original controls lose early notifications. R1984/85/86/88 retain explicit native/numeric conversions supported by prior x64 compiler controls. R1989 mask bit zero without truncating the handle. No changes to the selected busy record or task pairing.

verification.tests: x86/x64 each passed the five reenter modes: before-return, after-return, nested-return, pending-command, before-increment. The fixture checks present record with no wait and with pending wait.
verification.build: cached x86/x64 and explicit owning product/fixture links
